2026-W42.title: Enhance User Engagement in Personal Finance App
2026-W42.scenario: Our personal finance app has seen a 25% drop in daily active users over the past month, primarily due to a lack of engaging features. User feedback indicates that 40% find the app's budgeting tools cumbersome and not user-friendly, leading to increased churn among millennials.
targetObjectives: Increase daily active users by 15% within the next quarter.
Achieve a user satisfaction score of at least 4.5 out of 5 for the budgeting tools.
Reduce the drop-off rate in the budgeting feature from 60% to 30%.
constraints: Limited engineering resources with only two developers available for the next quarter.
Budget constraints cap new feature development at $50,000.
Existing app architecture limits significant UI changes without extensive refactoring.

2026-W43.title: Accelerate "Aha Moment" in Generative AI Productivity Tool
2026-W43.scenario: A browser-based AI document assistant has high initial signups (100k/mo), but 45% of users generate only one prompt and never return. User interviews reveal prompt blank-slate anxiety.
targetObjectives: Increase 3-prompt activation rate on Day-1 from 28% to 58%.
Lift Day-14 weekly active user (WAU) retention from 18% to 32%.
constraints: LLM API token costs cannot exceed $0.08 per activated free user.
Must maintain sub-800ms generation response streaming latency.
No intrusive mandatory interactive tutorials or tooltip tours.

2026-W44.title: Improve onboarding for a music streaming app.
2026-W44.scenario: A freemium music streaming app with 2M monthly downloads observes that 30% of new signups drop off before listening to a single track. Analytics indicate users get fatigued during mandatory onboarding genre/artist pickers and permission dialogs.
targetObjectives: Increase Day-1 first song completion rate from 70% to 85%.
Reduce time-to-first-song from 3.2 minutes to under 45 seconds.
Maintain Day-7 active listening retention above 42%.
constraints: Cannot require credit card or upfront payment.
3-sprint engineering budget across iOS and Android.
Must preserve user privacy and notification consent rates.
